distanceHint: Distance columns without a _km or _mi suffix are read in {unit}.
helpIntro: The first line names the columns, in any order. Required columns are in green, optional ones follow. Upper or lower case, accents, spaces and unit suffixes such as (km) are ignored, and French names (date, cout, kilometrage...) are accepted. Other columns are ignored.
